_comment: Hand-checked inputs for research/py/nse_build.py members. skip_releases: releases to ignore; effective_dates: dates the parser cannot find; names: symbols for releases that name companies only (key 'release:name' when a name maps to different symbols over time); drop_events / extra_events: changes NSE revoked, voided or announced outside the standard tables; symbol_changes: renames missing from NSE's symbol-change file; size_exceptions: periods when the index held a different number of securities; image_only: scanned releases and what they change. Every entry cites its release.

skip_releases.ind_prs04092009: Superseded by ind_prs09092009, which repeats the same changes with the effective date moved to 2009-10-22.

extra_events.name: BSE Ltd.
extra_events.why: Revocation table (not the standard layout): BSE included in place of IREDA.

drop_events.why: The Yes Bank -> Shree Cement swap announced for 2020-03-27 was brought forward to 2020-03-19 by ind_prs16032020.
ind_prs13052020: the replacements announced for 2020-03-27 were deferred (ind_prs23032020) and then declared null and void; the review was redone in ind_prs10062020 effective 2020-06-26.
Same as ind_prs18022020: null and void per ind_prs13052020.
ind_prs19032024 revoked IREDA's inclusion (impact cost) and included BSE in its place on 2024-03-28.
ind_prs25092024 revoked Vodafone Idea's exclusion before it took effect.
ind_prs25092024 revoked Central Bank of India's inclusion (the slot vacated by IDEA no longer existed).

symbol_changes: Missing from NSE's symbolchange.csv; bhavcopy shows WABCOINDIA to 2022-03-31 and ZFCVINDIA from 2022-04-01 (same ISIN).

size_exceptions.why: ind_prs22022016_2: Tata Motors DVR (TATAMTRDVR) was added as an additional security, so the Nifty 50 had 51 securities until ind_prs28082017 removed it.

image_only.ind_prs10092018: Scanned. Title: Strategy indices and the Nifty Tata Group index only; neither Nifty 50 nor Nifty Midcap 150.
image_only.ind_prs24092018: Scanned. Title: Nifty CPSE index only.
image_only.ind_prs16062018: Scanned. Arbitration order, no index changes.
image_only.ind_prs03122018: Scanned. ETF conference notice, no index changes.
image_only.ind_prs16052023: Scanned. Launch of the Nifty Core Housing index, no changes to existing indices.
image_only.ind_prs19062023: Scanned. Nifty Next 50 methodology, no constituent changes.

image_only.ind_prs23082021: Scanned (OCR checked). Says 'No changes are being made in NIFTY 50'. Its Nifty Midcap 150 list was replaced in full by ind_prs15092021 after the REIT/InvIT inclusions were revoked.
